integrity.known_prior_ingredients: Classical binomial pivotal-probability maximization and strictly dominated-strategy elimination are attributed to prior work.
integrity.proof_scope: Analytical statements for all finite group sizes are proved; exhaustive small-size arithmetic is supporting evidence only.
integrity.source_publication: First publicly posted arXiv version, not a later revision or journal date.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to the three-strategy independent-matching model with saturating defector risk, exact protective quorum, and continuous-time replicator dynamics.
Below the ceiling, positive selective advantage somewhere does not imply invasion, persistence, attracting coexistence, or stability.
Critical exclusion requires initially positive ordinary and protective cooperation; the invariant face without ordinary cooperation is not included.
No finite-population stochastic analogue or independent scientific validation is claimed.
title: Sharp cost ceiling, critical exclusion, and quorum reversals in protective public-goods dynamics
